exposure: 2-h plasma glucose value of oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT)
cohort: 15,194 pregnant women in 15 medical centers in Beijing from 20 June 2013 to 30 November 2013
finding: Over two-thirds of pGDM cases were diagnosed during pregnancy, and fasting plasma glucose should be used as the initial screening test for pGDM at the first antenatal care visit.
mod_finding: The incidence of cesarean delivery was lower in women with a 2-h plasma glucose ≥11.1 mmol/L during pregnancy compared to those with pGDM diagnosed before or during pregnancy based on HbA1c or fasting plasma glucose criteria.
